In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a '''Rodian Jedi''' was present at the briefing led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] prior to the [[First Battle of Kamino]]. The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] flew a [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 light interceptor]] with a team of other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as part of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] defense of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="Republic 50" />
